label: For every designated arrangement, a false-only judgment accepts an actual-false candidate and…
paraphrase: For every designated arrangement, a false-only judgment accepts an actual-false candidate and violates selection but has no truthful nonselection rival; a true-only judgment is factive and has the truthful nonselection rival and selection failure; a selection-defined positive calibration satisfies selection and factivity and accepts a supplied equality-selector. Reuses old truthful-rival controls; no arbitrary judgment is established actually adequate, and the positive selection-defined case supplies no independent warrant.
